title: XOR of a vector with itself
statement: For every $x \in \{0,1\}^n$, the componentwise XOR of $x$ with itself is the all-zeros vector: $x \oplus x = \mathbf{0}$.
hypotheses_covered: x ranges over the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
replaced:
For all $x \in \{0,1\}^n$, we have $x \oplus x = \mathbf{0}$, so every element
is its own inverse under XOR.
